comment: Desired user-scope agent surface for THIS machine, rendered by chezmoi. The source of truth is desired.json.tmpl in the chezmoi source repo: sync groups and per-machine differences are expressed there with chezmoi's native template data (each machine declares its groups in its chezmoi data; the template filters entries by group), so the rendered file at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/roundhouse/desired.json is already machine-specific and needs no runtime override layer. roundhouse:fleet-agents converges the host's managers to this file and propagates deliberate local changes back as commits to the chezmoi source.

plugins.comment: in the template, guard entries like this with a group conditional, e.g. {{ if has "xcode" .groups }}

mcpServers.comment: Full definition so a fresh host converges with `claude mcp add`; secrets stay in env vars, never here.
